column1: # tests/gh-graphql-reads-allowlist.tsv — BH-1585, widened by BH-1648. The GraphQL
# lines (`gh pr view|list`, `gh issue view|list|comment|close|edit`) each file under bin/ may still
# carry, as "<count> <path>". A file not named here is granted 0. Lower a grant
# when a conversion lands; never raise one — give the line a REST read
# (bin/lib/gh-rest.sh), or a `# gh-guard-allow: <reason>` that says why it
# bin/run-decompose.sh: the hit is prompt text handed to a model, not a call.
